transform: In place byte[i] ^= SS:[2045+(i mod52)], SI wraps16 bits; AL is XOR of pre-transform bytes
nonzero_return: DS=SS; AH=high byte of floor((count-1)/52); FAR consumes4 returnbytes, leaves6 argumentbytes
preserved_fixture: BP,SI,DI,SS,ES,IF/DF; allowed writes and exact write counts checked
domains: all256 one-byte inputs; zero/boundary/65535 lengths; SI wrap; three key/buffer aliases with sequential-memory oracle
scope: No native transform entry/exit trace, no arbitrary stack/code aliases, IRQs or Win16/remake parity. Byte3 is the selector1 gate; broader feature/format meaning remainspartial.
